stem: A Massachusetts pharmacy is preparing its next PMP Clearinghouse submission. Which dispensing transactions are generally included in the Schedule II-V/gabapentin reporting requirement? Select all that apply.

explanation.core_reasoning: Massachusetts pharmacy reporting covers Schedule II-V dispensations plus gabapentin, a designated Schedule VI drug of concern.

choice_analysis.A: Massachusetts specifically requires gabapentin reporting despite Schedule VI status.
choice_analysis.B: Ordinary Schedule VI warfarin is not within the II-V/gabapentin reporting rule.

related_facts: Covered transactions are reported within 24 hours or the next business day under current guidance.
explanation.mpje_trap: Either excluding gabapentin because it is Schedule VI or including every Schedule VI drug.
